name: 80202 · Denver, CO
findings: ZIP 80202 (Denver) has 597 nonprofit organizations. 313 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 272 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80202 (Denver) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
